## Notes

Five Project Assembly phases unlock tiers 3-4, 5-6, 7-8, 9, and the ending; phase 1 needs 50 Smart Plating, phase 5 needs Nuclear Pasta, Biochemical Sculptors, AI Expansion Servers, and Ballistic Warp Drives; progress is shared in multiplayer; completing phase 5 launches Project Assembly.
